lines.t: Yeah…
Questions from above, right into the core…
Not to shame… but to open the door…
You keep asking me why, but You already know
Every question that You send, just a heart X-ray glow
Not a courtroom vibe, no hammer, no chair
Just a mirror to my soul, You inviting me there
You ain’t digging up the past just to watch me bleed
You ain’t digging up the past just to watch me bleed
You exposing all the roots underneath my deeds
’Cause the sin on the surface ain’t the whole disease
It’s a wounded inner-man that’s too scared to speak
So I crack my chest open, let the memories fall
All the action-movie idols that I built as a wall
Predator, Rambo, every frame on repeat
Taught me power over pain, never taught me to weep
Search my heart with me, don’t leave me alone in it
Turn the lights on deep, yeah, I know You’re in it
If I never face me, how I’m gon’ answer You?
If I never trust love, how You gon’ walk me through?
Search my heart with me, pull the masks off slowly
I can dive that deep ’cause I know You know me
World made me numb, now Your fire’s on the dark
You’re after more than my hands, You’re after my heart
Heart scan, He demand, not to shame but to heal
Trap beat, tear leak, this is hardcore real
False copes in my grip, let ‘em burn, let ‘em part
He’s after more than my sins, He’s after my heart
Heart scan, He demand, not to shame but to heal
Trap beat, tear leak, this is hardcore real
False copes in my grip, let ‘em burn, let ‘em part
He’s after more than my sins, He’s after my heart
Self-help pages talk about trauma and scars
But they edit out the Name that made the galaxies spark
Church talk grace, talk blood, talk a slate wiped clean
But don’t sit with broken boys, where the pain still screams
So I’m stuck in between, stitched wrong at the seams
Doctrine like a blade, cutting off my screams
Calling vengeance “truth,” calling anger “zeal”
Calling justice “spiritual,” calling numb “healed”
But You asking me questions that dismantle my stance
Not to push me in the dirt, but to teach me to dance
Every “why do you fear?” that You echo inside
Is a doorway to the wound that I learned to hide
How I answer to You if I lie to myself?
How I talk about heaven while I’m running from help?
How I stay on the surface while You call me below?
Where the boys never cried ‘cause they weren’t allowed to show
Search my heart with me, don’t leave me alone in it
Turn the lights on deep, yeah, I know You’re in it
If I never face me, how I’m gon’ answer You?
If I never trust love, how You gon’ walk me through?
Search my heart with me, pull the masks off slowly
I can dive that deep ’cause I know You know me
World made me numb, now Your fire’s on the dark
You’re after more than my hands, You’re after my heart
This world raised us on violence,
Told us “feelings are weak”
So we armored up heavy,
Let our souls go to sleep
But You step in the silence,
Sit with shame in the room
Say, “Let’s walk through your memories,
Not to judge, but to groom”
Every commandment in order,
Every word that You spoke
Shows the heart comes first
Before the law we broke
So I surrender the persona,
Every image, every pose
Let the little boy inside
Finally come home
Heart scan, He demand, not to shame but to heal
Trap beat, tear leak, this is hardcore real
False copes in my grip, let ‘em burn, let ‘em part
He’s after more than my sins, He’s after my heart
Heart scan, He demand, in the wounds, He’ll start
Chillstep, 808s, but it’s open-heart art
I was molded to be frozen, torn emotions apart
Now I’m raging in His grace with a resurrected heart
